name: jpn-airport-taxi-guide
description: Combined taxi route guides for Tokyo Haneda (RJTT), Narita (RJAA) and Osaka Itami (RJOO): choose an airport, then follow standard arrival and departure taxi routes on a gridded airport map. For flight simulation.
